{{Top|leg}}
The '''invasion of Guiteica''' was the final engagement of the [[Bitthævrian War]]. A joint coalition of [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] forces invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Guiteica/Legends|Guiteica]] and defeated the native [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrian]] [[M'Yalfor'ac Order|warriors]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> Following their victory, many Kaleesh [[Kolkpravis|warriors]] took newly hatched [[Roggwart/Legends|roggwarts]] as war trophies.<ref name="EpGuide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>
